observations.population: Surveyed internet users aged 16+ in GWI's latest global sample, including China and Russia
observations.method: GWI survey respondents self-report whether they used each named platform within the preceding month
observations.limitations: Survey prevalence among internet users 16+, not a unique user census or number of people globally. Countries/regions vary in access and sampling; cannot multiply uncritically by world population.

observations.metric: Past-month YouTube use outside China and Russia
observations.population: GWI survey respondents aged 16+ in covered markets excluding China and Russia
observations.scope: Covered global economies excluding China and Russia
observations.method: Self-reported use during preceding month; aggregate recomputed after excluding China and Russia
observations.limitations: This is a different population than the 55.3% global figure. It is not the percentage of YouTube's own users outside China/Russia and not a national share of population.

observations.population: All YouTube uploads in official press-platform aggregate
observations.period: Press page live as checked 2026-10-23; averaging window not stated
observations.limitations: Reported platform upload count, not distinct creators or videos with sustained views. The press page does not state the sample window; count may change.

observations.population: Global YouTube Shorts views on the platform
observations.period: Press page live as checked 2026-10-23; averaging window not stated
observations.limitations: View events, not unique viewers or engaged views qualified for Shorts revenue. Metric definitions changed in 2026 and this count does not describe creator pay.

rules: Past-month survey prevalence is not advertising reach or a unique platform census.
Internet users aged 16+ excludes younger internet users and does not describe all residents.
20 million uploads daily is a volume, not the number of active creators.
200 billion Shorts views daily are events, not unique people or paying plays.
The two GWI proportions have different geographic denominators and must not be combined.
No observation defines the size or composition of an individual content subculture.
